Subject: Orchestra kickoff: preferred time slots, host/bridge owners, and tech preflight

Hi Diane —

Excited to get Olive Health into Orbit. Quick ask to lock the kickoff: can you confirm which of these windows works best for your team next week (all times PT):

- Tue 21 Sep: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed 22 Sep: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Thu 23 Sep: 08:30–10:00

We usually run a 90-minute session for week-zero: intros, success criteria, environment access, SSO/roles, and a tech preflight (SSH/S3/API keys). Attendees we recommend from Redwood: Prio (onboarding lead), Monica (technical lead), Marissa (CS lead). If you have a single point for SSO/IT and one for product/clinical, please loop them in — we need an attendee who can approve firewall/allowlist changes.

I attached a short prework PDF and the mutual action plan so you can glance at the agenda.

Thanks — available to hop on a quick call if you want to narrow the slots.

— Priyom

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the options. Wed 22 Sep 15:00–16:30 PT works best for our steering group (we need the later slot to include east-coast stakeholders).

I'll loop in our SSO lead, Aaron Chen (aaron.chen@olivehealth.com), for the preflight. Expect Aaron and our clinical product manager, Samira Kahn, on the invite.

Two quick asks before we lock:
1) Can you confirm whether the preflight requires any open ports from our side beyond standard Zoom and HTTPS?
2) We use Okta; do you have a short doc for the Okta metadata we should prep?

— Diane

Hi Diane — great, Wed 22 Sep 15:00–16:30 PT is locked on our side.

Quick answers:
- Ports: you only need HTTPS (443) outbound. If your network inspects TLS/terminates proxies, please ensure our callback endpoints are allowed; I'll paste the minimal endpoints in the calendar invite. No inbound ports required.
- Okta: I'll attach a one-page metadata checklist to the invite, and we can do a 10-minute SSO handshake during the kickoff if Aaron is available.

Host roles on our side:
- Meeting chair / success agenda: Marissa Cole (CS Lead)
- Technical demo / preflight: Monica Patel (Technical Lead)
- Implementation sequencing / MAP owner: Priyom Das
- Troubleshooting / escalation contact: Ben Carter (Escalations) — Ben, appreciate if you can stay on the invite.

I've also added the prework doc to Drive and noted two quick items for your IT team (Okta metadata, API key access for test environment).

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
